records.source: To Farmer @:^My knee's acting up again, and you know what helps? ^Rubbing the darn thing with hot pepper.^ Trouble is, my supply's run dry. If you've got one to spare I'd be much obliged.^   -George %item quest 105 %%[#]George Needs A Pepper
records.translation: Para kay Magsasakang @:^Sumasakit na naman ang tuhod ko, at alam mo ba kung ano ang nakatutulong? ^Ang pagkuskos dito ng maanghang na sili.^ Ang problema, naubos na ang suplay ko. Malaki ang pasasalamat ko kung may maibibigay kang isa.^   -George %item quest 105 %%[#]Kailangan ni George ng Sili

records.source: Dear @,^I'd like to give my cows a special treat. They're such good girls and hungry, too. Could you bring me one bunch of amaranth? They love the stuff. ^Thanks, Dear.^   -Marnie %item quest 106 %%[#]Marnie's Request
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^Gusto kong bigyan ng espesyal na pagkain ang mga baka ko. Napakabait nila at gutom na rin. Maaari mo ba akong dalhan ng isang bungkos ng Amaranto? Gustong-gusto nila iyon. ^Salamat, mahal.^   -Marnie %item quest 106 %%[#]Kahilingan ni Marnie

records.source: Hello,^It's blackberry season right now. The bushes are full of them. I want to pick some, but I lost my basket. Can you help?^   -Linus%item quest 107 %%[#]Linus Lost His Basket
records.translation: Kumusta,^Panahon ngayon ng blackberry. Hitik sa mga iyon ang mga palumpong. Gusto kong mamitas, pero nawala ko ang aking basket. Maaari mo ba akong tulungan?^   -Linus%item quest 107 %%[#]Nawala ni Linus ang Kaniyang Basket

records.source: @-^I'd like to buy a pumpkin from you. My daughter and I want to carve a jack-o-lantern for the upcoming Spirit's Eve festival. ^   -Caroline%item quest 108 %%[#]Caroline's Request
records.translation: @-^Gusto kong bumili ng Kalabasa mula sa iyo. Gusto naming mag-ukit ng parol na kalabasa ng anak ko para sa nalalapit na Bisperas ng mga Espiritu. ^   -Caroline%item quest 108 %%[#]Kahilingan ni Caroline

records.source: Hey, I've got a little challenge for you:^    Catch me a squid.^You can fish them from the ocean at night. They only show up in the winter, though.^   -Willy%item quest 109 %%[#]Willy's Challenge
records.translation: Hoy, may munting hamon ako para sa iyo:^    Manghuli ka ng Pusit para sa akin.^Maaari mong hulihin ang mga iyon sa karagatan sa gabi. Tuwing taglamig lamang sila lumilitaw.^   -Willy%item quest 109 %%[#]Hamon ni Willy

records.source: I've got an unusual request. Could you keep this a secret?^ I want you to deliver an amethyst to Emily. It's her favorite stone. Tell her it's from me.^   -Clint %item quest 110 %%[#]Clint's Unusual Request
records.translation: May kakaiba akong kahilingan. Maaari mo ba itong ilihim?^ Gusto kong ihatid mo ang isang Ametista kay Emily. Paborito niya ang batong iyon. Sabihin mong galing iyon sa akin.^   -Clint %item quest 110 %%[#]Kakaibang Kahilingan ni Clint

records.source: @-^I am researching the forgotten art of shadow divination. I require an item known as 'Void Essence'. Bring it to me and you will be rewarded.^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard %item quest 111 %%[#]Wizard's Request
records.translation: @-^Sinasaliksik ko ang nakalimutang sining ng panghuhula sa anino. Kailangan ko ng bagay na tinatawag na 'Esensiya ng Kawalan'. Dalhin mo iyon sa akin at gagantimpalaan kita.^ -M. Rasmodius, Mago %item quest 111 %%[#]Kahilingan ng Mago

records.source: @,^Sorry to bother you again, but I need another favor.^I got a new hammer and I want to try it on a variety of metals.^Could you smelt an iron bar and bring it to me? ^Thanks.^ -Clint %item quest 112 %%[#]Clint's Request
records.translation: @,^Paumanhin sa muling pag-abala sa iyo, pero kailangan ko ng isa pang pabor.^May bago akong martilyo at gusto ko itong subukan sa iba't ibang metal.^Maaari ka bang magtunaw ng Lingoteng Bakal at dalhin iyon sa akin? ^Salamat.^ -Clint %item quest 112 %%[#]Kahilingan ni Clint

records.source: @-^How are you doing? Hope the winter hasn't been too hard on you.^Anyway, I'm writing to ask you for some hardwood. I need about ten pieces, if you've got it.^If not, no worries. Take Care!^  -Robin%item quest 113 %%[#]Robin's Request
records.translation: @-^Kumusta ka? Sana ay hindi naging napakahirap para sa iyo ang taglamig.^Sumusulat ako upang humingi ng Matigas na Kahoy. Kailangan ko ng mga sampung piraso, kung mayroon ka.^Kung wala, ayos lang. Mag-ingat ka!^  -Robin%item quest 113 %%[#]Kahilingan ni Robin

records.source: Dear @-^I want to make fish stew, but I need an albacore! I know they're almost out of season... sorry about the short notice. Could you catch one for me?^   -Gus%item quest 114 %%[#]Gus Needs A Certain Fish
records.translation: Mahal kong @-^Gusto kong gumawa ng nilagang isda, pero kailangan ko ng Albakora! Alam kong malapit nang matapos ang panahon ng mga iyon... paumanhin sa biglaang pakiusap. Maaari ka bang manghuli ng isa para sa akin?^   -Gus%item quest 114 %%[#]Kailangan ni Gus ng Isang Isda

records.source: Notice:^^The price of raw materials at Robin's shop and Clint's shop has increased.[#]Raw Material Price Notice
records.translation: Abiso:^^Tumaas na ang presyo ng mga hilaw na materyales sa tindahan ni Robin at sa tindahan ni Clint.[#]Abiso sa Presyo ng Hilaw na Materyales

records.source: @-^I'm really craving a fresh apricot. I haven't been able to find one at the store, so I'm asking you. I'll pay you well for it!^   -Emily%item quest 115 %%[#]Emily's Request
records.translation: @-^Gustong-gusto kong kumain ng sariwang Aprikot. Wala akong makita sa tindahan, kaya sa iyo ako humihingi. Magbabayad ako nang malaki para rito!^   -Emily%item quest 115 %%[#]Kahilingan ni Emily

records.source: Dear @,^I'd like to surprise my husband with a gift. He's a big fan of leeks. Could you bring me one?^   -Granny Evelyn%item quest 116 %%[#]Evelyn's Surprise
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^Gusto kong sorpresahin ang asawa ko sa pamamagitan ng isang regalo. Paboritong-paborito niya ang Porro. Maaari mo ba akong dalhan ng isa?^   -Lola Evelyn%item quest 116 %%[#]Sorpresa ni Evelyn

records.source: NOTICE^Pierre here... I really, really want a plate of sashimi. I'll pay top coin to whoever brings me some.^   -Pierre%item quest 117 %%[#]Pierre's Craving
records.translation: ABISO^Si Pierre ito... Gustong-gusto ko talaga ng isang plato ng Sashimi. Malaki ang ibabayad ko sa sinumang magdadala sa akin niyon.^   -Pierre%item quest 117 %%[#]Pinananabikan ni Pierre

records.source: Fisherman Wanted^I need a good pufferfish specimen. I'm conducting an experiment on the toxin created by the pufferfish.^Reward: 1000g^ -Demetrius%item quest 118 %%[#]Demetrius' Study On Toxins
records.translation: Naghahanap ng Mangingisda^Kailangan ko ng magandang espesimen ng Isdang Buntal. Nagsasagawa ako ng eksperimento sa lasong nililikha ng Isdang Buntal.^Gantimpala: 1000g^ -Demetrius%item quest 118 %%[#]Pag-aaral ni Demetrius sa mga Lason

records.source: Dear Farmer @,^I'd like to give my wife a starfruit for our anniversary. Are you growing any on your farm? If you brought me one, I'd be very grateful.^   -Kent%item quest 119 %%[#]Kent Needs A Gift
records.translation: Mahal kong Magsasaka @,^Gusto kong bigyan ang asawa ko ng Balimbing para sa anibersaryo namin. May itinatanim ka ba niyon sa bukid mo? Lubos akong magpapasalamat kung dadalhan mo ako ng isa.^   -Kent%item quest 119 %%[#]Kailangan ni Kent ng Regalo

records.source: @,^I need truffle oil. Don't ask me why.^ -Mayor Lewis%item quest 120 %%[#]Lewis' Request
records.translation: @,^Kailangan ko ng Langis ng Truffle. Huwag mo nang itanong kung bakit.^ -Alkalde Lewis%item quest 120 %%[#]Kahilingan ni Lewis

records.source: Wanted: 1 Fresh Lobster for a marvelous bisque I'm creating.^Who: Gus, proprietor of the Stardrop Saloon^Reward: 800g %item quest 121 %%[#]Gus Needs Lobster
records.translation: Kailangan: 1 sariwang Lobster para sa napakasarap na bisque na ginagawa ko.^Humihiling: Gus, may-ari ng Saloon ng Patak-Bituin^Gantimpala: 800g %item quest 121 %%[#]Kailangan ni Gus ng Lobster

records.source: NOTICE^Does anybody have one of them battery packs? My TV remote died, and it's a real hassle getting off the couch to change the station.^  -Pam%item quest 122 %%[#]Pam Needs Help
records.translation: ABISO^Mayroon ba sa inyong may Pakete ng Baterya? Naubusan ng karga ang remote ng telebisyon ko, at napakahirap bumangon sa sopa para magpalit ng estasyon.^  -Pam%item quest 122 %%[#]Kailangan ni Pam ng Tulong

records.source: @,^I'm creating an enchanted staff of phenomenal power.^However, I'm missing something: an Iridium Bar.^I'm willing to pay 5x the market value for it. Bring it as soon as you can.^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard %item quest 123 %%[#]Wizard Needs A Rare Item
records.translation: @,^Lumilikha ako ng engkantadong tungkod na may pambihirang kapangyarihan.^Gayunman, may kulang ako: isang Lingoteng Iridyum.^Handa akong magbayad nang limang ulit sa halaga nito sa pamilihan. Dalhin mo iyon sa lalong madaling panahon.^ -M. Rasmodius, Mago %item quest 123 %%[#]Kailangan ng Mago ng Bihirang Bagay

records.source: I've got another challenge for you: Catch me a Lingcod.^They don't go down easy, but I know you can do it.^  -Willy%item quest 124 %%[#]Willy's Challenge #2
records.translation: May isa pa akong hamon para sa iyo: Manghuli ka ng Lingcod para sa akin.^Hindi ito madaling magpahuli, pero alam kong kaya mo iyon.^  -Willy%item quest 124 %%[#]Hamon ni Willy #2

records.source: Dear @,^I'm at my wit's end. I desperately want to make a Coco-no-no at the saloon, but I have no way of getting a coconut!^Can you help me?^  -Gus%item quest 125 %%[#]Gus Needs A Coconut
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^Hindi ko na alam ang gagawin. Gustong-gusto kong gumawa ng Coco-no-no sa saloon, pero wala akong paraan upang makakuha ng Niyog!^Matutulungan mo ba ako?^  -Gus%item quest 125 %%[#]Kailangan ni Gus ng Niyog

records.source: Dear @,^Tomorrow is the Feast of the Winter Star.^Did you get a gift for your 'secret friend'... %secretsanta?^The feast starts at 9 AM in the town square. See you then! ^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Feast Of The Winter Star Reminder
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^Bukas na ang Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig.^May regalo ka na ba para sa iyong 'lihim na kaibigan'... si %secretsanta?^Magsisimula ang piging nang alas-nuwebe ng umaga sa liwasang-bayan. Magkita tayo roon! ^   -Alkalde Lewis[#]Paalala sa Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig

records.source: Dear Mr. @,^Last night, a Joja team member found you incapacitated. A medical team was dispatched to bring you home safely.^We're glad you're okay!^^(You've been billed {0}g for this service)^^-Morris^Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative[#]Joja Invoice
records.translation: Mahal kong G. @,^Kagabi, natagpuan ka ng isang kawani ng Joja na walang malay. Nagpadala ng pangkat medikal upang ligtas kang maiuwi.^Natutuwa kaming maayos ka na!^^(Sinisingil ka ng {0}g para sa serbisyong ito)^^-Morris^Kinatawan ng Kasiyahan ng mga Mamimili ng Joja[#]Singil ng Joja

Nagpadala ng pangkat medikal upang ligtas kang maiuwi.^Natutuwa kaming maayos ka na!^^(Sinisingil ka ng {0}g para sa serbisyong ito)^^-Morris^Kinatawan ng Kasiyahan ng mga Mamimili ng Joja[#]Singil ng Joja

records.source: Dear Mr. @,^Last night, a Joja team member found you incapacitated. A medical team was dispatched to bring you home safely.^We're glad you're okay!^^Since you have no money, we were obligated by law to provide this service free of charge.^^-Morris^Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative[#]Legally Required Notice
records.translation: Mahal kong G. @,^Kagabi, natagpuan ka ng isang kawani ng Joja na walang malay. Nagpadala ng pangkat medikal upang ligtas kang maiuwi.^Natutuwa kaming maayos ka na!^^Dahil wala kang pera, inaatasan kami ng batas na ibigay nang libre ang serbisyong ito.^^-Morris^Kinatawan ng Kasiyahan ng mga Mamimili ng Joja[#]Abisong Hinihingi ng Batas

A medical team was dispatched to bring you home safely.^We're glad you're okay!^^Since you have no money, we were obligated by law to provide this service free of charge.^^-Morris^Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative[#]Legally Required Notice
records.translation: Mahal kong Bb. @,^Kagabi, natagpuan ka ng isang kawani ng Joja na walang malay. Nagpadala ng pangkat medikal upang ligtas kang maiuwi.^Natutuwa kaming maayos ka na!^^Dahil wala kang pera, inaatasan kami ng batas na ibigay nang libre ang serbisyong ito.^^-Morris^Kinatawan ng Kasiyahan ng mga Mamimili ng Joja[#]Abisong Hinihingi ng Batas

records.source: @, ^You're lucky I found you last night! You were unconscious, and someone was searching your pockets. I have no idea how much money they took... they ran away as soon as I approached. Be more careful!^^-Linus[#]Note From Linus
records.translation: @, ^Mapalad kang natagpuan kita kagabi! Wala kang malay, at may taong kinakapkapan ang mga bulsa mo. Hindi ko alam kung magkano ang kinuha nila... tumakas siya nang lumapit ako. Mag-ingat ka!^^-Linus[#]Liham mula kay Linus

records.source: @,^Someone dropped you off at the clinic last night. You'd passed out from exhaustion!^You've got to take better care of yourself and go to bed at a reasonable hour.^I've billed you {0}g to cover your medical expenses.^^-Dr. Harvey[#]From The Office Of Dr. Harvey
records.translation: @,^May naghatid sa iyo sa klinika kagabi. Nawalan ka ng malay dahil sa labis na pagod!^Kailangan mong higit na alagaan ang sarili mo at matulog sa tamang oras.^Sinisingil kita ng {0}g para sa mga gastusing medikal mo.^^-Dr. Harvey[#]Mula sa Tanggapan ni Dr. Harvey

records.source: @,^Someone dropped you off at the clinic last night. You'd passed out from exhaustion!^You've got to take better care of yourself and go to bed at a reasonable hour.^Since you have no money, I provided your medical care free of charge.^^-Dr. Harvey[#]Harvey's Free Medical Service
records.translation: @,^May naghatid sa iyo sa klinika kagabi. Nawalan ka ng malay dahil sa labis na pagod!^Kailangan mong higit na alagaan ang sarili mo at matulog sa tamang oras.^Dahil wala kang pera, ibinigay ko nang libre ang pangangalagang medikal sa iyo.^^-Dr. Harvey[#]Libreng Serbisyong Medikal ni Harvey
